brief: The east half is not missing itineraries — `spawnLaneAgent` already routes people to the plaza, the quay, the church green, the towpath and the allotments. It is missing budget. All of those hang off one `roll` cascade in one function under one `laneCap` (~2976) that peaks at 9 in full daylight, and the bands are narrow: the quay takes roll 0.48–0.53 and the green 0.53–0.58, so roughly a tenth of a small budget reaches everything east of the plaza. That is why the quay benches, the bandstand and the orchard are almost always empty. Give the far side its own arrival source with its own cap, so the east reads as populated at midday without starving the lane.
successLooksLike: A midday wide shot has people on the quay and on the church green at the same time as the lane is busy; a night shot is still quiet. Census `people` rises at midday and comes back down at night.
avoid: Do not fix this by raising `laneCap` — that floods the lane in order to populate the far bank. Do not add new far-bank destinations; the ones that exist are under-used, which is the entire point.
